title: Secondary Air Injection Pump Failure
caption:
🚨 2005–2013 Toyota Tundra owners: got a random check engine light on cold starts?

Your Secondary Air Injection Pump can fail from water intrusion (wheel well + rubber boot traps moisture), triggering codes like P2440/P2443/P2445/P2447.

Watch for: ✅ jet-engine noise on cold startup ✅ check engine light (sometimes limp mode).

Typical repair cost: $1500–$4000 depending on parts/labor.
